pages.title: One place to find local menus and order what you love.
pages.lede: OnDaMenu brings the menus of neighborhood restaurants together so you can see what is cooking nearby, build your order and pay online. For restaurants, it is a simple way to take online orders without changing how the kitchen already works.

panels.title: Built for the way neighborhoods eat
panels.subtitle: Real menus from local kitchens, in one easy place.
panels.body:
The best food in any neighborhood usually comes from its own restaurants, not a chain. OnDaMenu puts those menus side by side, with every dish and price laid out clearly, so choosing dinner takes minutes instead of a dozen browser tabs.

Pick a restaurant, add what you want to your cart and pay online. Your order goes straight to the restaurant, which prepares it the same way it would for a guest at the counter.

panels.title: Own a restaurant?
panels.subtitle: Meet diners where they already look.
panels.body: List your menu on OnDaMenu and take online orders through the Clover point of sale you run your counter with. One menu, one system, more local customers. Your dishes and prices stay under your control.

pages.stepsTitle: From hungry to ordered in three steps.

closing.title: Bring your restaurant to OnDaMenu
closing.text: Tell us about your restaurant and we will walk you through getting your menu online.

pages.title: Order from the places that make your neighborhood taste like home.
pages.lede: OnDaMenu shows you full menus from local restaurants in one place. Browse by restaurant, see every dish with its price, put together exactly the order you want and pay online when you are ready.

panels.title: The whole menu, not a shortlist
panels.subtitle: See everything the kitchen offers before you decide.
panels.body:
Each restaurant on OnDaMenu shows its full menu, organized by category the way the restaurant itself arranges it. Dishes, sides and drinks are listed with their prices, so there are no surprises when you reach the checkout.

Add items to your cart as you go, change quantities, remove what you no longer want and review the total before you pay. The restaurant receives your order as soon as your payment is confirmed.

panels.title: Know where you are eating
panels.subtitle: Health inspection grades, built in.
panels.body: For New York City restaurants, OnDaMenu shows the Health Department inspection grade published by the city, so you can order with confidence. The grades come straight from the city’s open data, not from us.

pages.featuresTitle: What you can do on OnDaMenu

banner.title: Good food is closer than you think.
banner.text: Neighborhood restaurants, their full menus and a simple way to order, all in one place.

closing.title: Is your favorite spot missing?
closing.text: Tell us which restaurant you would like to see on OnDaMenu, or let the owner know we would love to have them.

pages.title: Take online orders without adding another system to run.
pages.lede: OnDaMenu puts your menu in front of diners in your area and sends their orders to the Clover point of sale you already use. You keep running your kitchen the way you do today; we bring the online customers.

panels.title: Your menu, online and under your control
panels.subtitle: Set it up once, then change it whenever the kitchen does.
panels.body:
Your OnDaMenu page shows your restaurant's profile and your full menu, arranged in the categories you choose. From your merchant account you can add dishes, update prices and take items off the menu when they sell out.

Diners build their order and pay online. Because OnDaMenu connects to Clover, those orders arrive alongside the ones you take in person, so your staff works from a single system.

panels.title: Works with Clover
panels.subtitle: The register you know.
panels.body: Connect your Clover account when you sign up. OnDaMenu uses it to keep online orders and payments in step with the rest of your business. Your staff keeps working from the screen they already know.

banner.title: More local diners, same kitchen.
banner.text: Show your menu to people nearby who are deciding what to eat right now.

closing.title: Ready to put your restaurant on the menu?
closing.text: Send us your restaurant's details and we will help you get your menu online.

features.title: Browse full menus
features.text: Every dish, side and drink a restaurant offers, organized by category with prices shown up front.

features.title: Build your order
features.text: Add items as you browse, adjust quantities and review your total before you commit to anything.

features.title: Pay online
features.text: Check out on your phone or computer. Your order is sent to the restaurant as soon as payment goes through.

features.title: Check the inspection grade
features.text: See the city's published health inspection grade for New York City restaurants before you order.

features.title: Pickup or local delivery
features.text: Collect your order yourself, or have an OnDaMenu courier bring it when you are within one mile of the restaurant. Delivery is a flat $7.50, shown before you pay.

features.title: Your menu online
features.text: A clear, organized menu page for your restaurant that diners can browse on any device.

features.title: Orders through Clover
features.text: Online orders and payments connect to your Clover point of sale, next to your in-person sales.

features.title: Easy menu updates
features.text: Add dishes, change prices or mark items unavailable from your merchant account whenever you need to.

features.title: Your restaurant profile
features.text: Tell diners who you are and what you serve, so your restaurant stands out to people ordering nearby.

features.title: Delivery handled for you
features.text: OnDaMenu couriers deliver within one mile of your restaurant. Diners pay a flat $7.50 delivery fee, and you can choose to cover part or all of it.

steps.title: Find a restaurant
steps.text: Browse local restaurants and open the full menu of any that catch your eye.

steps.title: Build your order
steps.text: Add the dishes you want to your cart and check the total as you go.

steps.title: Pay online
steps.text: Check out in a few taps, then pick up your order or have it delivered if you are within a mile.
